solution_steps: Activate Tribute to the Doomed, discard Black Pendant and destroy Marshmallon.
Enter Battle Phase and attack with everyone.
Activate Mystical Space Typhoon and destroy Snatch Steal.
Enter Main Phase 2 and Summon Red-Eyes B. Dragon by tributing Kozaky and Burning Algae.
